title: Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams
abstract: arXiv:2610.00583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: People are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, and those agents are increasingly encountering other people's agents over shared resources such as a codebase, a calendar, or a budget. When each agent acts for a different user with different goals, coordination often fails, and the group ends up worse off than if a single agent had acted for everyone. We study this multi-user, multi-agent setting across five frontier models and 77 scenarios in four environments: an API key environment in which agents share a compute budget, a clinic in which they share a calendar, a personal assistant environment in which they share a group order or booking, and a merge queue in which they share a release cutoff. In each scenario, we compare a single agent that serves every user (a coordinator) to a team in which each agent serves one user, with and without a communication channel between the agents. Teams deliver worse group outcomes than the coor

translated_title: 一起更糟：多用户多智能体团队中性能如何崩坏
translated_abstract: 人们越来越多地将任务委托给AI智能体，而这些智能体也越来越多地在共享资源（如代码库、日历或预算）上遇到其他用户的智能体。当每个智能体代表具有不同目标的不同用户行动时，协调往往会失败，导致整个群体的结果比由单个智能体为所有人服务时更糟。我们在五个前沿模型和四个环境中的77个场景下研究了这种多用户、多智能体设置：智能体共享计算预算的API密钥环境、共享日历的诊所环境、共享团购订单或预订的个人助理环境，以及共享发布截止时间的合并队列环境。在每个场景中，我们将服务所有用户的单个智能体（协调者）与每个智能体各自服务一个用户的团队进行比较，团队中的智能体之间在有或没有通信渠道两种情况下进行测试。团队给出的群体结果比协调者……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文首次在五个前沿模型、四个环境和77个场景中系统研究了多用户多智能体协作问题，发现当各智能体分别代表不同用户行动时，团队的整体结果劣于由单个协调者智能体服务所有用户的情况。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to systematically study multi-user multi-agent settings across five frontier models, four environments, and 77 scenarios, finding that teams of agents each serving a different user deliver worse group outcomes than a single coordinator agent serving everyone.
